name: AMD Instinct MI300X
memory_bandwidth_basis: 8,192-bit memory interface x 5.2 Gbps per-pin data rate / 8 = 5,324.8 GB/s, rounded by AMD to '5.3 TB/s'. AMD states this derivation verbatim in footnote MI300-05A. Eight HBM3 stacks, one per XCD. The spec table's 'Memory Clock 5.2 GHz' column is the per-pin data rate, not a base clock.
notes:
EIGHT compute dies in ONE OAM package. vram_gb 192 is the whole module: 8 Accelerator Complex Dies (XCDs) x 38 enabled CUs = 304 CUs, plus 4 I/O dies on one interposer. A reader must NOT assume this is two 96GB addressable halves - the 8 XCDs are fully connected on-package over Infinity Fabric and the 192GB is one coherent GPU address space.

FP64 is absent from the flops list because the schema's precision enum has no fp64. AMD's two FP64 numbers: 163.4 TFLOPS Matrix (MFMA) and 81.7 TFLOPS Vector - MI300X is the first CDNA part where FP64 Matrix equals FP32 Matrix instead of being 2x it.

Dense vs sparse is the most important thing on this record. AMD publishes every AI precision twice: once dense, once 'with Structured Sparsity' (2:4). The sparse number is exactly 2x dense, every time. Do not compare a MI300X sparse FP8 figure against an NVIDIA dense FP8 figure.

CDNA3 added TF32 and FP8 (both absent on MI200, per the MI300X datasheet footnote) plus native structured sparsity. ROCm microarch FLOPS/clock/CU: Vector TF32 1024, Matrix FP16/BF16 2048, Matrix FP8/INT8 4096, Matrix FP64 256, Vector FP64 128, Matrix FP32 256, Vector FP32 256 - aggregated over 304 CUs at 2.1 GHz.

Inference relevance: 192 GB HBM3 at 5.3 TB/s plus a 256 MB Infinity Cache LLC is capacity- and bandwidth-favourable for large-batch decode and KV-cache-resident models. 750W, 54V UBB, passive OAM, 8 Infinity Fabric links at 128 GB/s peak. ROCm LLVM target gfx942.
